canonical_data: A generated project repository of documents and code in a local workspace directory, plus in-process role memory and an optional document store
current_repo_note: Covers the MetaGPT framework in this repository. The MGX hosted natural-language programming product the README advertises is a separate commercial service and is not reviewed here. One vendored mineflayer-collectblock folder under the Minecraft environment carries its own MIT licence file.
strengths: Role, action, and environment classes implement the software-company SOP as code: a team runs for a bounded number of rounds, stops when every role is idle, and writes a project repository
A team-level investment budget feeds a cost manager with a maximum, giving a concrete spend limit rather than an advisory one
One of the most-starred multi-agent frameworks in the catalog, with a large unit-test tree and a published research lineage including AFlow and SPO
weaknesses: The last push to the default branch was in January 2026, and the README's newest news item predates it, so the open framework has been quiet while the company's attention moved to the MGX product
No Model Context Protocol support was found in the package, so tool integration relies on the framework's own action classes
Human involvement is by substituting a human provider for a role, and no approval gate in front of the run-code action was found in the roles reviewed
why_it_matters: The framework that popularised role-based software-company agents, still the reference point for SOP-driven multi-agent coordination and the baseline many newer orchestrators are compared against.
